knowledge_gaps: The proposal is a useful diagnostic repair, but its pseudocode is not executable: the probe registry, dependency graph, authoritative routing manifest, exported-loader API, fixtures and acceptance thresholds remain unspecified.

Mutation detection needs an independent oracle and explicit fault-to-probe mapping. Otherwise a probe may merely detect the injected flag or share the mutant's incorrect computation. Report unchanged-control acceptance, fault activation, detection and inconclusive cases separately.

The disabled-padding-mask fixture needs clarification. Changing padding token IDs also changes a mask derived from sequence != 0; shifting tokens changes learned absolute positions. Neither is a valid equivalence test without independent control of masks and position IDs.

Restoring global RNG and model mode does not restore a consumed training loader, worker RNG, sampler generator or mutable model buffers. Cache bounded diagnostic batches and specify state preservation so diagnostics cannot change subsequent training.

The diagnostic cap has no numerical allocation, fixture counts or stopping policy. Distinguish completed checks from checks skipped because of budget, and record per-probe cost across all four categories.

The code analyzer describes an adapter without sensitivity or serving checks, while inspiration results contain both. Identify the exact supplied baseline and adapter version before deciding which probes to preserve or repair.

The originality rating of 4 is plausible for an integration contribution. Potential 7 and difficulty 4 are provisional: no measured detection coverage, runtime or downstream usefulness supports them. First compare isolated dependency/error-reporting repairs with the added mutation suite; no new training intervention is justified yet.

The metamorphic-testing reference lacks verified bibliographic details and demonstrated relevance to these specific relations. Electronics' selected interval is exploratory across multiple reported comparisons and does not establish excessive recency dependence or a validation improvement.

follow_up_queries.reason: Resolve the main fixture-design ambiguity and establish independent checks for shared implementation mistakes.
follow_up_queries.query: For PyTorch BERT4Rec with left-padded histories, learned absolute position embeddings, key-padding masks and appended-MASK inference, how can independent metamorphic and mutation tests detect count-minus-one readout and disabled padding masking while preserving valid-token positions? Include discriminating fixtures, numerical tolerances and treatment of behaviorally equivalent mutants.

follow_up_queries.reason: Make diagnostic execution reproducible without changing the fixed training trajectory.
follow_up_queries.query: How should read-only PyTorch diagnostics preserve training state when consuming a DataLoader with custom samplers, dedicated torch.Generator objects, multiprocessing workers and persistent workers? Compare cached diagnostic batches with RNG restoration, including module modes, buffers, hooks and exception cleanup.

follow_up_queries.reason: Verify the cited foundation and replace subjective usefulness claims with a measurable diagnostic evaluation.
follow_up_queries.query: What are the exact title, authors and methods of arXiv:2507.04354, and which established neural-network mutation-testing studies define mutation coverage, equivalent mutants and unchanged-control false-positive rates? How can those criteria evaluate a bounded BERT4Rec diagnostic suite without claiming recommendation-accuracy gains?
